evidence.title: Incorporating Context and External Knowledge for Pronoun Coreference Resolution
evidence.quote: The CoNLL-2012 shared task BIBREF21 corpus is used as the evaluation dataset, which is selected from the Ontonotes 5.0. Following conventional approaches BIBREF9 , BIBREF11 , for each pronoun in the document, we consider candidate $n$ from the previous two sentences and the current sentence. For pronouns, we consider two types of them following BIBREF9 , i.e., third personal pronoun (she, her, he, him, them, they, it) and possessive pronoun (his, hers, its, their, theirs). Table 1 reports the number of the two type pronouns and the overall statistics for the experimental dataset. According to our selection range of candidate $n$ , on average, each pronoun has 4.6 candidates and 1.3 correct references.
